record.original_question: Find two inheritances where the first equals 10 dirhams minus the square root of the second inheritance, and the second equals 5 dirhams minus the square root of the first inheritance.

evidence.quote: Problem 17. A person receives an inheritance of 10 dirhams decreased by the square root of the inheritance of a second person. The inheritance of the latter is equal to 5 dirhams decreased by the square root of the inheritance of the first person.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Find two positive real numbers $x$ and $y$ satisfying the system\n$$x = 10 - \sqrt{y}, \qquad y = 5 - \sqrt{x},$$\nequivalently $x+\sqrt{y}=10$ and $y+\sqrt{x}=5$. Determine all such pairs $(x,y)$ (with $x,y\ge 0$ so that the square roots are real).

status_evidence.title: Classical algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Polynomial systems in two unknowns of small degree are solvable by elimination and the quadratic/quartic formulas.
status_evidence.claim: The system reduces to a polynomial equation in one variable of degree at most 4 and is therefore solvable in closed form.

artifact.status_search_result: This is a classical algebra exercise reducible to a polynomial equation of degree at most four in one unknown via the substitutions $u=\sqrt{x}$, $v=\sqrt{y}$, and is solvable in closed form by standard elimination.
